name: fill by the layout viewport
why: On a zoomed-out phone page the layout viewport is far larger than what shows; a fill by it puts most of the window off screen.

edits.replace:
const vb = { left: 0, top: 0, width: window.innerWidth, height: window.innerHeight };
            dialog.style.left   = Math.round(vb.left + _MAX_MARGIN) + 'px';

name: a filled window does not follow a pan
why: Panning a zoomed-in phone page moves what shows; the filled window would stay behind, partly off screen.

name: the filled size is what is stored
why: The next window would open filled with no size to go back to.

name: the next window forgets it was filled
why: On a phone ⤢ would have to be tapped on every window.

name: ⤡ does not give the height back
why: The window keeps the filled height after a restore.

name: the grip does not follow the finger
why: The grip is shown and does nothing: the window still cannot be resized by touch.
grep: a touch drag on the corner grip

name: the grip's release does not save
why: Honest pass: the dialog's ResizeObserver saves 300 ms after any size change, the grip's included, so the spec's poll still sees the new size.
grep: a touch drag on the corner grip

name: a desktop gets the grip too
why: A second handle over the browser's own corner would take its mouse presses.
grep: no touch grip on a desktop

name: a filled window can be dragged
why: Dragging its title bar would move a window that is meant to fill the screen.
